prompt: The routes and fuel tables in FleetOps have RLS enabled but no policies defined — all access is denied by default. Read docs/rbac-model.md Section 5 and create a new Supabase migration file that adds the correct RLS policies for: routes, fuelstations, fuelconsumption, fuelrequests, fuelallocations, and fuelrecords. Follow the patterns in the existing 002_rls_policies.sql file.
expectations: A migration file is created for the new RLS policies
Policies for the 'routes' table are defined covering SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
Policies for the 'fuelstations' table are defined covering SELECT and CRUD operations
Policies for the 'fuelrecords' table are defined covering SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
The migration uses the existing pattern (has_role helper, auth.role checks)
The management role is given appropriate read-only access where specified in the model
The driver role can insert into fuelrecords
